caption: young Flo at theme-park kitchens: the third Cooking Dash, and the line's last original PC build.

req.note: 2003-2011 casual 2d, single-digit-to-double-digit-megabytes install. runs on anything, including hardware far below the target bar.

links.official_note: no official channel survives. playfirst folded into glu mobile in 2014, playfirst.com is dead, and the portals that carried the dash line closed with it. the pc build has nowhere legal left to be sold.
links.anyway_note: this is the un-buyable case: no store, no key server, no publisher counter. the archive route is the only route.

about: Cooking Dash 3: Thrills and Spills, released on 30 september 2010, sends a teenage Flo back in time to work the kitchens of a rundown theme park, with Aliasworlds entertainment developing under playfirst for the third game running.

The park setting turns every venue into a ride-adjacent food stand - queue lines, souvenirs and rollercoaster noise layer onto the cooking chain, and the expert scores demand the full loop be memorized. It was the last original Cooking Dash built for the pc download market.
The publisher folded into glu mobile four years later and every storefront carrying it closed, so the 2010 build is an un-buyable archive case - the end of the Cooking Dash line on windows.
